n201258f959.headline: China’s Xi promises to protect free trade at Apec as Trump snubs major summit
n201258f959.summary: Xi Jinping promised to protect free trade at the APEC summit, which has been overshadowed by a Trump-Xi meeting arranged on the sidelines.
n201258f959.why: APEC brings together major Asia-Pacific economies, and US-China trade relations shape tariffs, supply chains and global growth.

n03825c4033.headline: MHA Reports 13% Revenue Growth And Confirms Full-year Outlook
n03825c4033.summary: MHA reported a strong first half of FY26, with revenue up 13% to £121.3 million, in line with market expectations, and confirmed its full-year outlook.
n03825c4033.why: MHA is a UK-listed professional services group, so its half-year results and outlook inform investors about its growth and trading.

n37f0373488.headline: House price growth slips back amid subdued buyer confidence, Nationwide says
n37f0373488.summary: Nationwide said UK house price growth fell month-on-month in October to 0.3%, down from 0.5% in September, citing subdued buyer confidence.
n37f0373488.why: Nationwide is one of the UK's largest mortgage lenders, and its house price index is a closely watched gauge of housing demand and mortgage conditions.

nebda542cdc.headline: Can Ethiopia’s economic liberalisation lead to a jobs boom?
nebda542cdc.summary: Government reforms have raised hopes of a business revolution in Ethiopia, but entrepreneurship remains misunderstood, African Business reports.
nebda542cdc.why: Economic liberalisation, such as opening markets and easing controls on business, shapes foreign investment and job creation in developing economies.

n160b999e0c.headline: Estonia Plans Gradual Reduction of Online Gambling Tax to Boost Industry and Culture
n160b999e0c.summary: Estonia plans to lower its online gambling tax gradually from 6% to 4%. The phased approach is projected to lift revenue and attract international operators.
n160b999e0c.why: Gambling tax rates influence where online operators choose to be licensed and how much revenue governments collect from the sector.

nfce9117f86.headline: BoG engages Eastern region informal sector groups on financial literacy
nfce9117f86.summary: The Bank of Ghana has intensified its public sensitisation campaign on consumer protection and financial literacy. The outreach includes informal sector groups in the Eastern Region.
nfce9117f86.why: The Bank of Ghana is the country's central bank and regulator. Consumer protection and financial literacy initiatives shape how households and informal businesses use banking and financial services.

n9cae435cd0.headline: Industry minister discusses economic cooperation with Japan, Vietnam during APEC gathering
n9cae435cd0.summary: Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan held bilateral meetings with his Japanese and Vietnamese counterparts on economic cooperation during an APEC gathering.
n9cae435cd0.why: APEC ministerial meetings coordinate trade and investment policy among Asia-Pacific economies, which affects regional supply chains.

n2324f135bc.headline: NERC urges FG to utilise REA $2b to industrial hubs
n2324f135bc.summary: The Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission has urged the Federal Government to spend a significant part of the $2 billion available to the Rural Electrification Agency on industrial hubs.
n2324f135bc.why: The Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission oversees the country's power sector, and allocation of electrification funds affects power supply for industry. Reliable power is a key cost factor for manufacturers.

n682fa88499.headline: China’s Xi promises to protect free trade at Apec as Trump snubs major summit
n682fa88499.summary: China's Xi Jinping promised to protect free trade at the APEC summit. The event was overshadowed by a Trump-Xi meeting arranged on its sidelines, which Trump did not attend.
n682fa88499.why: US-China trade relations drive tariffs, supply chains and export demand that feed directly into global equity and commodity markets.

source.name: East London and West Essex Guardian Series

sources.name: East London and West Essex Guardian Series

nee43e643f8.headline: Fresnillo To Acquire Probe Gold In C$780 Million All-cash Deal
nee43e643f8.summary: Fresnillo plc agreed to acquire 100% of Probe Gold Inc. for C$3.65 per share, valuing the deal at about C$780 million (US$560 million). The transaction is all cash.
nee43e643f8.why: Fresnillo is a major silver and gold producer, and acquisitions like this expand its reserves and production pipeline.

n176a45b1e1.headline: Gold prices edge higher in Dubai after Fed rate cut
n176a45b1e1.summary: Gold prices in Dubai rose slightly on October 31, supported by a stronger global outlook, steady central-bank demand and a US Fed rate cut.
n176a45b1e1.why: Gold is a traditional store of value that tends to respond to changes in US interest rates and central-bank buying.

nb2000d44ca.headline: Aggrieved NDK Finance customers demand release of locked-up funds after financial sector cleanup
nb2000d44ca.summary: Some NDK Finance customers are demanding release of locked-up funds years after the government's financial sector cleanup. They say they have not yet received the full amounts owed.
nb2000d44ca.why: Financial sector clean-ups in Ghana involved closing or restructuring weak lenders, and unresolved customer claims affect confidence in the wider non-bank financial sector.

n81023eec2f.headline: Automakers take a hit from tariffs, but some still see strong earnings
n81023eec2f.summary: Automakers have paid billions of dollars in tariffs on imported cars, parts and materials. Some carmakers nonetheless reported strong performance on recent earnings calls.
n81023eec2f.why: Automakers rely on global supply chains, so import tariffs directly affect their costs and margins.

source.name: WKU Public Radio | The Public Radio Service of Western Kentucky University

sources.name: WKU Public Radio | The Public Radio Service of Western Kentucky University

nd4ad0c0b4c.headline: SNAP benefits expiring and health care premiums set to skyrocket Saturday
nd4ad0c0b4c.summary: The ongoing government shutdown is affecting millions of Americans as SNAP food benefits expire and health care premiums rise. No resolution is in sight.
nd4ad0c0b4c.why: A prolonged federal shutdown delays government services and spending, affecting consumer demand and the broader economy.

n9bd01368e2.headline: Petrol may hit N1,163/litre as FG targets N4.8tr yearly from fresh tariff
n9bd01368e2.summary: Nigeria's government is proposing a new tariff regime that could push petrol to about N1,163 per litre. The plan targets N4.8 trillion in yearly revenue from the tariff.
n9bd01368e2.why: Fuel prices affect transport costs, inflation and consumer spending in Nigeria. Changes to tariffs on imported fuel can also affect the naira and government revenue.

source.name: The Guardian Nigeria News - Nigeria and World News

sources.name: The Guardian Nigeria News - Nigeria and World News

n531f90fbd7.headline: Reps probes tax deductions, multiple charges by banks
n531f90fbd7.summary: Nigeria's House of Representatives has set up an ad-hoc committee to investigate growing concerns over excessive tax deductions from the earnings of civil servants. Multiple bank charges are also under review.
n531f90fbd7.why: Banks in Nigeria handle salary payments and tax collection, so deduction rules and charges affect both bank revenues and public-sector incomes.

na6b86241a1.headline: Minority demands urgent clarity from GoldBod on sources of gold purchases
na6b86241a1.summary: Ghana's Parliament minority is demanding urgent answers from the Ghana Gold Board over where it sources gold. Concerns center on possible purchases from unregulated or illegal mining operations.
na6b86241a1.why: The Ghana Gold Board buys gold from domestic miners and its sourcing affects export credibility and the country's gold trade.

n7362173bc3.headline: Zenith Bank’s gross earnings surge 16% to N3.4trn, as PBT hits N917.4bn in Q3 2025
n7362173bc3.summary: Zenith Bank's gross earnings rose 16% to N3.4trn, with profit before tax reaching N917.4bn in the third quarter of 2025. The bank cited resilience despite a challenging macroeconomic environment.
n7362173bc3.why: Zenith Bank is one of Nigeria's largest commercial banks, so its results signal conditions in Nigeria's banking sector and broader economy.

nc773c19bd6.headline: Candy prices up 10.8% for Halloween amid cocoa shortages and tariffs, analysis says
nc773c19bd6.summary: Candy prices are up 10.8% ahead of Halloween, according to an analysis, amid cocoa shortages and tariffs. Consumers are facing higher costs at store checkouts.
nc773c19bd6.why: Cocoa is a key input for confectionery makers, so cocoa supply and tariffs feed into food-company margins and consumer price inflation.

impacts.name: Cocoa
impacts.why: Cocoa shortages are cited as a driver of higher candy prices, indicating tight cocoa supply.

n3a1d8043a7.headline: Data storage firms Western Digital, Seagate soar on AI-driven demand spike
n3a1d8043a7.summary: Shares of Seagate and Western Digital have sharply outperformed the broader market this year. Demand for hard drives in the global race to build AI infrastructure has powered the rally.
n3a1d8043a7.why: Western Digital and Seagate are major hard disk drive makers, and demand for data storage from AI and data centres drives their revenue.
n3a1d8043a7.why_moved: Demand for hard drives in the global race to build AI infrastructure has pushed shares of both storage makers well ahead of the broader market this year.

n4248258d3d.headline: Fuel Tax: Don't inflict more pain on Nigerians, ADC tells...
n4248258d3d.summary: The African Democratic Congress has opposed President Bola Tinubu's approval of a 15 percent import duty on petrol and diesel. It said the measure would further burden Nigerians.
n4248258d3d.why: Import duties on refined fuel affect pump prices, inflation and the cost of transport in Nigeria, which imports much of its refined petroleum.

nb01f5bbcc9.headline: Pakistan stock markets continue to bleed, plunges over 1,600 points
nb01f5bbcc9.summary: The KSE-100 benchmark fell over 1,600 points amid rising geopolitical tensions and disappointment, the report said.
nb01f5bbcc9.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, tracking the country's largest listed companies.
nb01f5bbcc9.why_moved: The input cites rising geopolitical tensions and disappointment as the backdrop for the sharp fall.

n2154929692.headline: Barclays, BofA sees no further ECB easing in 2025
n2154929692.summary: Barclays and BofA Global Research no longer expect the European Central Bank to cut interest rates at its December meeting, after the ECB kept rates unchanged.
n2154929692.why: The ECB sets interest rates for the euro area, and its policy path influences euro bond yields, the euro exchange rate and borrowing costs across the bloc.

n4143e1a5e2.headline: India's fiscal deficit for April-Sep stands at 36.5 pc of full-year target
n4143e1a5e2.summary: The fiscal deficit for April to September stood at Rs 5.73 lakh crore, which equals 36.5% of the full-year target.
n4143e1a5e2.why: The fiscal deficit measures the gap between government spending and revenue, shaping sovereign borrowing and bond supply.

n24b1db7f05.headline: Running on fumes by third week
n24b1db7f05.summary: E-hailing drivers in Malaysia criticised the Budi RON95 fuel scheme, saying their personal 300-litre allocations are used up by work before the month ends.
n24b1db7f05.why: The RON95 fuel subsidy scheme changes the cost and availability of petrol for drivers and households, which affects fuel demand and government spending.

n3a57bf4781.headline: Capital A on track for PN17 exit in December
n3a57bf4781.summary: Capital A Bhd has cleared a key hurdle to be lifted out of Practice Note 17 status by the end of this year. PN17 classification applies to Bursa Malaysia-listed companies with financial weakness.
n3a57bf4781.why: Capital A is the parent of AirAsia group, a Malaysian low-cost airline operator. Exit from PN17 removes a listing-status restriction on the stock.

n4628f55e06.headline: Vape prices to soar across Ireland from tomorrow as new government tax kicks in
n4628f55e06.summary: Vape prices in Ireland rise from the next day as a new government tax takes effect. The government says the measure is part of a crackdown on youth vaping.
n4628f55e06.why: Excise changes on tobacco and vaping products affect retail prices and the revenue position of the state.

n7d78a131d6.headline: Govt Planning to Increase Taxes on Mobile Calls, Solar and Cash Withdrawal
n7d78a131d6.summary: Pakistan has assured the IMF it will implement Rs. 200 billion in additional tax measures in January if revenue targets are not met. The planned measures include levies on mobile calls, solar and cash withdrawals.
n7d78a131d6.why: The International Monetary Fund lends to Pakistan under a support programme tied to fiscal targets. Tax changes on telecoms and energy affect consumer spending and government revenue.

n21b92cd934.headline: Xeneta: U.S.–China Trade Truce Won’t Stop Container Rate Slide Into 2026
n21b92cd934.summary: A 12-month US-China trade truce announced this week will not prevent ocean container freight rates from continuing to decline into 2026, according to Xeneta analysis.
n21b92cd934.why: Container freight rates reflect global shipping demand and capacity, and they feed into retailers', manufacturers' and shipping lines' margins.

n259526b259.headline: Continued criticism of trade deal politically driven, says Anwar
n259526b259.summary: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim rejected claims by Muhyiddin Yassin and Mahathir Mohamad, insisting the trade pact serves Malaysia's long-term interests.
n259526b259.why: Trade agreements set tariff and market-access terms that affect Malaysia's exporters and foreign investment. Domestic political opposition can influence how durable such deals are.

n44455c447c.headline: iPhone 17 arrives in Gaza at unbelievable price — knafeh and pizzas are also back
n44455c447c.summary: The iPhone 17 Pro Max is available in Gaza at US $11,000 as life begins to normalize and prices ease post-conflict.
n44455c447c.why: The availability and pricing of high-end electronics reflect economic recovery and consumer demand in Gaza amid ongoing tensions.

n8616f9bf05.headline: Why Tinubu approved 15 per cent import duty on petrol – FIRS chairman, Adedeji
n8616f9bf05.summary: Nigerian President Tinubu has approved a 15% import duty on petrol, according to the FIRS chairman.
n8616f9bf05.why: Changes in import duties directly impact Nigeria's fuel prices, government revenue, and inflation, influencing the economy and markets.

ndba90f9d4a.headline: Kyrgyzstan Achieves Self-Sufficiency in Six Staple Food Products
ndba90f9d4a.summary: Kyrgyzstan is now fully self-sufficient in six key food products, reducing reliance on imports.
ndba90f9d4a.why: Food self-sufficiency can impact domestic inflation, trade balances, and regional food security.

n6f695173ad.headline: Guinea-Bissau arrests senior army officers for alleged coup attempt
n6f695173ad.summary: Guinea-Bissau arrests senior army officers ahead of elections amid political instability.
n6f695173ad.why: Political instability can impact economic stability, foreign investment, and regional security in West Africa.

nf2c6fd9dac.headline: SiGMA Empowers Maltese Companies To Go Global
nf2c6fd9dac.summary: SiGMA supports Maltese firms in expanding internationally, emphasizing Malta’s role in the digital economy.
nf2c6fd9dac.why: International growth initiatives can boost local tech sectors and attract foreign investment.

n8b1d2b748e.headline: APEC opens after Trump, Xi move to ease trade tensions
n8b1d2b748e.summary: The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit has opened, with regional leaders emphasizing efforts to reduce trade tensions between the US and China.
n8b1d2b748e.why: The summit's focus on trade tensions impacts regional economic stability and investor sentiment in Asia-Pacific markets.
n8b1d2b748e.why_moved: Trade tensions easing between US and China reduce uncertainty, boosting regional markets and investor confidence.

ne9914aabaf.headline: BYD enters the Japanese ‘Kei Car’ market with the Racco EV
ne9914aabaf.summary: BYD enters Japan's Kei Car segment with the Racco EV, featuring an electric powertrain and compact design.
ne9914aabaf.why: Expansion into new markets and EV offerings can influence automotive industry dynamics and EV supply chains.

n464b3ff4c0.headline: Ecopetrol announces the dates for the publication of its third quarter of 2025 earnings report and conference call
n464b3ff4c0.summary: Ecopetrol plans to release its Q3 2025 financial results and hold a conference call, providing insight into Colombia's largest oil producer.
n464b3ff4c0.why: Ecopetrol's earnings impact Colombia's energy sector and can influence regional oil markets.

impacts.why: Earnings results can influence Colombia's energy sector outlook.

nfef56e243b.headline: Port of Tauranga pegs earnings guidance as high as $147m
nfef56e243b.summary: Port of Tauranga expects underlying earnings between $137 million and $147 million for the 12 months ending June 2026.
nfef56e243b.why: Earnings guidance from major ports influences shipping, trade, and regional economic outlooks.

n809ae3fe6b.headline: Niagen Bioscience, Inc. (NAGE) Stock Analysis: Unveiling A 125% Potential Upside In Biotech
n809ae3fe6b.summary: UK business confidence plunges to the lowest level on record, citing higher labor costs as a key factor.
n809ae3fe6b.why: Business confidence levels influence investment, hiring, and economic growth prospects in the UK.

n8a6a4e949f.headline: APEC leaders to open summit after Trump, Xi agreed on steps to ease trade tensions
n8a6a4e949f.summary: Leaders of 21 Asia-Pacific nations meet after Trump and Xi Jinping agree to take measures to reduce trade tensions.
n8a6a4e949f.why: Easing trade tensions can boost regional economic cooperation and market stability.
